notes: Curated set of 6 verified farms covering meat/organs, dairy, oysters, and wild fish. Each farm tagged with the diet profiles it serves and a short 'best for' label.

farms.name: Miller's Organic Farm
farms.description: Direct Aajonus-lineage Amish farm in Pennsylvania. The only farm appearing in every category of Aajonus's official sourcing list. Known for A2/A2 raw dairy, no-salt cheeses made with homemade rennet, grass-fed/pastured meats, organs, and exotic dairy (water buffalo, camel). Members-only herd-share for legal reasons; ships nationwide via private membership.
farms.verification_source: Listed in Aajonus Vonderplanitz's official sourcing materials across every category (dairy, meat, organs).

products.notes: A2/A2 cow, goat, water buffalo, and camel options.
No-salt cheeses made with homemade rennet to Aajonus's specifications.
Liver, heart, kidney, sweetbreads available on request.

tips.title: How to order
tips.body: Call the farm directly. Membership signup happens by phone — they will guide you through the herd-share agreement. Once you're a member, place orders via phone or their members-only portal.

tips.title: Why members-only
tips.body: Direct raw-milk sales across state lines are heavily restricted. The herd-share model means you technically own a share of the herd, which is legal in all 50 states.

farms.name: Mark Nolt Farm
farms.description: Old-school Amish farm in Newville, PA. No website — phone-only ordering. Aajonus personally praised this farm in his sourcing materials. Best as a backup option when Miller's is sold out, especially for raw dairy and pastured meats.
farms.verification_source: Named in Aajonus Vonderplanitz's published sourcing recommendations.

tips.title: Phone-only ordering
tips.body: No website, no online portal. Call during business hours. Be patient — they may take a message and call back.

tips.title: Pickup vs ship
tips.body: Primarily a pickup farm. Shipping options are limited compared to Miller's.

farms.name: Northstar Bison
farms.description: Wisconsin bison ranch with a verified fresh-never-frozen program. Cut Mon-Tue, ships Wed for Thu delivery. The cleanest option in the US for raw bison meat and bison organs. Strong choice for raw carnivore eaters who want grass-fed red meat without the dairy focus.
farms.verification_source: Listed in Aajonus's meat sourcing materials.

products.notes: Bison cuts: ribeye, sirloin, ground, roasts.
Bison liver, heart, tongue, marrow bones, suet.
Elk and venison sometimes available seasonally.

tips.title: Order timing
tips.body: Place orders before Monday morning to hit the Mon-Tue cut window. Wednesday shipments arrive Thursday in most US zones.

tips.title: Specify fresh
tips.body: Default ship is fresh-never-frozen. Confirm at checkout — frozen is sometimes substituted for distant zones.

farms.name: Dutch Meadows Farm
farms.description: Pennsylvania Amish farm. Strongest #2 alternative to Miller's for A2/A2 dairy, kefir, ghee, and broths. Often has organ meats in stock when Miller's is sold out. Easier ordering process than Miller's — public website with online checkout.
farms.verification_source: Personally vetted as a backup to Miller's. RAWMI-aligned standards, A2/A2 herd.

tips.title: Easier than Miller's
tips.body: Standard online checkout. No phone call required for first order. Shipping logistics are handled in-cart.

farms.name: Hama Hama Oyster Company
farms.description: Sixth-generation family-run shellfish farm on Washington's Olympic Peninsula at the mouth of the Hama Hama River. Hood Canal waters are among the cleanest cold-water oyster regions in North America. Ships live oysters overnight nationwide. The default oyster pick for raw eaters in the lower 48.
farms.verification_source: Personally vetted. Cold Hood Canal waters, family-run, transparent harvest practices.

products.notes: Live Pacific and Kumamoto oysters, manila clams, geoduck (seasonal).

tips.title: Order Mon-Wed
tips.body: Order Mon-Wed for delivery Tue-Fri. They don't ship for weekend delivery (oysters sit too long).

tips.title: Storage
tips.body: Store flat-side-up in fridge with a damp towel over them. They'll keep 7-10 days alive.

farms.name: Vital Choice
farms.description: Wild Alaskan and Pacific seafood. Sablefish, salmon, halibut, sardines. Flash-frozen at sea. The most reliable nationwide source for high-fat wild cold-water fish — sablefish in particular is hard to find anywhere else and is a staple for raw carnivore eaters who want fish fat.
farms.verification_source: Personally vetted. Wild-only inventory, transparent sourcing, flash-frozen at sea.

products.notes: Sablefish, sockeye salmon, king salmon, halibut, cod.

tips.title: Bulk savings
tips.body: Bigger orders qualify for free shipping and bring per-pound cost down significantly. Sablefish in 5-lb increments is the sweet spot.

tips.title: Sablefish > everything
tips.body: If you've never had wild sablefish, start there. Highest fat content of any wild fish, melts at room temp, eats well raw.
